sections.Profile:
In "F-14 Tomcat," players take on the role of a Navy pilot with the callsign "Hitman," tasked with defeating the Russian General Yagov. F-14 Tomcat pinball, released by Williams in 1987, is a high-speed, aviation-themed game designed by Steve Ritchie. This machine was notable for being the first to feature a four-ball multiball and an "Autosave" ball save feature, which gives players another chance if the ball drains too quickly.
